description: This Java source file defines an Akka actor class 'AcksUpdater' responsible for managing local acknowledgement labels in a distributed pub/sub system. It handles subscription management, local state updates, and synchronization with distributed data (DData) through Akka's replicator, as well as reacting to cluster membership changes.

classes.name: AcksUpdater
classes.description: An Akka actor managing local acknowledgment labels for pub/sub communication, handling subscription requests, updating distributed data, and reacting to cluster membership changes.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props configuration for spawning AcksUpdater actor instances.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handlers for the actor, including reacting to DData changes and cluster member removal events.

methods.name: getDDataWriter
methods.description: Returns the distributor data writer used for updating acknowledgment labels.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription requests, denying duplicates or remote claims, and adding new subscriptions.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Periodically invoked to flush local DData updates.

methods.name: ddataOpSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful DData operations, currently logs unexpected success.

methods.name: onChanged
methods.description: Handles updates from the DData replicator, updating local state and checking for acknowledgment conflicts.

methods.name: writeLocalDData
methods.description: Commits local changes to the distributed data of acknowledgment labels.

methods.name: failSubscribe
methods.description: Notifies a subscriber that their acknowledgement label claim failed due to duplication.

methods.name: areAckLabelsDeclaredHere
methods.description: Checks if acknowledgment labels declared in a subscription conflict with existing ones.

methods.name: getLocalLosers
methods.description: Determines which local subscribers lost race conditions for acknowledgment labels against remote claims.

methods.name: areTopicsClaimedRemotely
methods.description: Checks if topics claimed in a subscription are already taken remotely.

methods.name: isSmallerThanMySubscriber
methods.description: Determines if another subscriber has a lesser comparison value than the current, used for conflict resolution.
